title: Irish Crispy Cheese Casserole
description: A comforting, cheesy casserole with a crunchy topping, perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: Cook casserole mix according to package instructions.
In a separate bowl, mix together flour and melted butter to create casserole crust.
Press crust mixture into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top crust with cooked casserole mix.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top of the casserole mix.
Sprinkle crushed crispy onions over the cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
